name: pet-town
description: A transparent desktop village for live Herdr agents

scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:repo && turbo run lint
scripts.lint:repo: pnpm run lint:python && pnpm run lint:shell && pnpm run lint:actions && pnpm run lint:toml
scripts.format: prettier --write . && ruff format scripts && shfmt -w scripts/*.sh && cargo fmt --manifest-path apps/pet-town/src-tauri/Cargo.toml && taplo format
scripts.format:check: prettier --check . && ruff format --check scripts && shfmt -d scripts/*.sh && cargo fmt --manifest-path apps/pet-town/src-tauri/Cargo.toml -- --check && taplo format --check
scripts.check:quality: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && turbo run lint:rust
scripts.check: pnpm run check:quality && pnpm run check:lines && pnpm run check:flow && pnpm run check:focus && pnpm run check:interactions && pnpm run check:remote-ui && pnpm run check:godot-remote && pnpm run check:broker && pnpm run check:preferences && pnpm exec turbo run build internal:build-frontend && pnpm exec turbo run check:rust && pnpm run check:packaged
